The extensive list of `optdepends` reflects the modular nature of the `litellm` library, which supports many integrations, but these are declared cleanly and serve documented purposes (e.g., proxy, CLI, or runtime functionality). No obfuscated commands, unexpected network calls, or dangerous operations are present in this metadata file.
